report.summary: Reviewed events.py: defines event dataclasses, TransportRecord, and event_to_transport_record function. All docstring claims checkable within chunk are kept.
risks: TransportRecord.from_dict | medium | Uses hardcoded keys 'record_id', etc. without validation; if data dict is malformed, KeyError will be raised. | Add explicit key existence checks or use .get() with defaults.

event_to_transport_record | medium | For SessionStarted and other events not explicitly handled, falls back to json.dumps(payload). This may produce a different content format than expected. | Verify that the fallback content is acceptable for all event types.

event_to_transport_record | low | record_id construction uses session_id, direction, and sequence; if any of these contain colons, the format could be ambiguous. | Consider using a separator not allowed in session IDs or encode session_id.

observations.what: TransportRecord.from_dict does not validate that data dict contains all required keys; missing keys will cause KeyError.

event_to_transport_record handles SessionStarted, SessionEnded, TextDelta, ToolRequested, ToolCompleted, FileRead, CommandOutput, AgentMessage explicitly; other event types fall back to json.dumps(payload).
The record_id format uses colon separators; if session_id contains colons, parsing could be ambiguous.
embedding_text method strips the result; trailing whitespace is removed.
